EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING
  MINUTES
  MAY 23, 2016

CALL TO ORDER
CHAIRWOMAN SCHMITZ called the meeting to order, the time being 7:00 p.m. in the Rolling
Hills Estates City Council Chambers.

COMMITTEE MEMBERS PRESENT
Susan Brtis
Lisa Hawkins
Bill Kemp
Pam Schachter
Chairwoman Velveth Schmitz
Vicki Shinn
Carrie Silvano
Victor Yoo

COMMITTEE MEMBER ABSENT – EXCUSED

Carol Dean-Porter
Patricia Harik

STAFF MEMBERS PRESENT
Andy Clark, Community Services Director

DRAFT MINUTES OF APRIL 25, 2016

MEMBER BRTIS moved, seconded by MEMBER SHINN

  TO APPROVE THE DRAFT MINUTES OF THE APRIL 25 28, 2016 EQUESTRIAN
  COMMITTEE MEETING AS PRESENTED.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRWOMAN SCHMITZ SO ORDERED.

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES
MAY 23, 2016  1
 AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA
Melody Colbert, 4604 Rockbluff Drive, Rolling Hills Estates, informed the Equestrian
Committee that she was disappointed about the number of riders this year. She noted that
some riders took their own route to Howlett Park due to delays in the start of the ride in past
years, and the “Thursday Morning Trail Ride Group” had no riders in attendance this year.

PROPOSED EQUESTRIAN STRUCTURES PROJECT

MEMBER SCHACHTER reviewed the specification details for the new Horse Show Office,
Horse Show Judges Booth, and Dressage Judges Booth that the Howlett Park Equestrian
Structures Subcommittee had revised with the assistance of a representative Alan Prefab
Buildings. She noted that the specifications selected for the structures were to assure that
they all lasted for many years in the park. In response to CHAIRWOMAN SCHMITZ inquiry,
MEMBER SCHACHTER indicated that this manufacturer stated that the units would likely
take 2 to 3 months to construct and install. In response to MEMBER HAWKINS’ inquiry
regarding the use of used metal containers for the new structures, the Community Services
Director indicated that this option was considered but not desired by the Equestrian
Committee, Park and Activities Commission, or City Council when the original bid packet was
assembled.

CHAIRWOMAN SCHMITZ stated that she would not be able to attend the regular fourth
Monday of the month Equestrian Committee meeting to finalize the structure specifications for
a recommendation to the Park and Activities Commission. The Community Services Director
suggested that a Special Equestrian Committee meeting be considered and the Committee
concurred the meeting date should be June 7, 2016 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council
Chambers.

ASSISTANT TRAINER BUSINESS LICENSES

As directed at the last meeting, the Community Services Director verified with the City’s
Administrative Services Department that Assistant Trainers should also purchase annual
Horse Trainer Permits. He noted that Linda Cooper, licensed Horse Trainer at the Peter
Weber Equestrian Center, had been notified that her two Assistant Trainers needed to obtain
a Horse Trainers Permit. In response to the Community Services Director’s inquiry, no
Equestrian Committee Member was aware of any other Assistant Trainers teaching in the
public arenas. CHAIRWOMAN SCHMITZ requested that staff send all a notification to all
licensed Trainers that Assistant Trainers also needed to obtain and maintain a current
business license.

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES
MAY 23, 2016  2
 CITY CELEBRATION EQUESTRIAN ACTIVITIES

MEMBER SCHACHTER reviewed a draft list of potential demonstrations, horsemanship
events, clinics, sponsors, and booths that could be considered at this year’s new venue.
CHAIRWOMAN SCHMITZ complimented MEMBER SCHACHTER on the comprehensive list
of potential equestrian activities which she had put together thus far. The Community
Services Director noted that the activities appeared to being offered all day and was
concerned that there will be music and performances on a nearby stage in the afternoon,
which could be disruptive to some of the proposed afternoon equestrian events. He also
noted that the next City Celebration Subcommittee meeting would be held on Monday, June
20, 2016 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers following the Park and Activities
Commission’s Adjourned Park Tour Meeting starting at 6:00 p.m. in Ernie Howlett Park.

EQUESTRIAN ISSUES LOG
HEARING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRWOMAN SCHMITZ RECEIVED AND FILED THE
EQUESTRIAN ISSUES LOG.

ADOPT-A-TRAIL REPORTS

There were no trail issues reported by Equestrian Committee Members.

MEMBER SHINN informed the Equestrian Committee that the first Dreamscape Dressage
Show was very successful.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
CHAIRWOMAN SCHMITZ requested that the potential meeting date that each Future Agenda
Item will be agendized be indicated for each item.

A.  Potential New Dressage Arena
B.  New Peter Weber Equestrian Center Restroom Building
C.  Horse Trailer Parking at PWEC
D.  New Howlett Park Permit Regulations – No Balloons or Flags Near Equestrian Center
E.  For-Profit Horse Show Organization Fees
F.  Chandler Park Arena Overcrowding
G.  Assistant Trainers Business License
H.  Additional Horse Arena in Chandler Park

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES
MAY 23, 2016  3
 ADJOURNMENT
MEMBER SHINN moved, seconded by MEMBER SILVANO

  TO ADJOURN THE EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING.

HEARING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRWOMAN SCHMITZ ADJOURNED THE MEETING.

The meeting adjourned at 7:36 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Andy Clark
Community Services Director

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES
MAY 23, 2016  4
